subject.title: feat(browser): add secure per-tab copilot panel

question: Should this secure rebuild become the canonical per-tab copilot implementation and supersede or absorb the still-open implementation at https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/93680?
rationale: Both PRs implement the same user-facing side-panel direction but use materially different ownership and security architectures; source-level review cannot choose the permanent product and ownership boundary without maintainer intent.

options.title: Adopt the secure rebuild
options.body: Treat this PR as the canonical implementation after the stale-token recovery fix and upgrade/real-behavior proof are supplied, then explicitly resolve the relationship with the earlier PR.

options.title: Continue the earlier implementation
options.body: Keep the earlier PR as the product path and close or narrow this rebuild to any independently valuable security contracts.

options.title: Request a unified successor
options.body: Pause both implementations until maintainers define a single ownership plan that preserves the chosen UI while avoiding duplicate panel and Gateway paths.

recommendation.title: Adopt the secure rebuild
recommendation.body: Treat this PR as the canonical implementation after the stale-token recovery fix and upgrade/real-behavior proof are supplied, then explicitly resolve the relationship with the earlier PR.

likelyOwner.reason: The referenced earlier implementation and its stated product direction make this person the most directly connected available decision contact.
